To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the photoelectrochemical properties and the photoelectroc catalytic performance of TiO2 can be enhanced by modifying the surface with metal nanoparticles.

TiO2 NT arrays loaded with nanoparticles Pt, Pd or Ru show great variation on the performance of different photoelectrocatalyic reactions, and Pt TiO2 shows the best performance in photoelectrocatalytical hydrogen evolution.
TiO2 nanofibers modified with platinum group metals show great variations in photoelectrochemical reactions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the modification of TiO2 by platinum group metal nanoparticles and their application in the photoelectrochemical field, which is of great interest in the future research.
the development of new materials with high photoelectrochemical properties for practical applications.

platinum group metal nanoparticles loaded TiO2 nanofibers are a good choice in the application of photoelectrochemical reaction, which is a promising material for future energy applications.

the photoelectroc catalytic degradation and hydrogen evolution reactions could be improved by using platinum group metals modified TiO2 nanorods as photoanode, while only platinum modified TiO2 NT could be used as cathode.
